name: @fetch-hive/mcp-gateway
stderr:
OpenAPI to MCP — connect a live or local API to Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, and agents.

Usage: mcp-gateway [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init      Create config, cache dir, and an MCP bearer token
  add-spec  Compile an OpenAPI document and register it
  list      List registered specs
  inspect   Show spec, tool, or client paste snippets
  auth      Manage upstream credential references
  serve     Serve a spec over Streamable HTTP or stdio
  tunnel    Expose any Streamable HTTP or stdio MCP server through an anonymous tunnel. The status
            screen matches `serve --tunnel`: method, status, duration, path, and JSON-RPC method.
            Colors follow --color and NO_COLOR. With no RUST_LOG and [log] level left at info,
            library logs use warn,rmcp=off
  doctor    Run local health checks
  login     Sign in to a Fetch Hive account. Optional. Anonymous tunnels do not require it
  logout    Revoke the CLI token and delete credentials.toml
  tunnels   List, reserve, and release persistent tunnel names
  whoami    Show the signed-in Fetch Hive account
  test      Call one tool through the same proxy path as serve
  logs      Read the local JSON log file
  version   Print build metadata
  upgrade   Replace this binary from a GitHub Release
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>         Path to config.toml (overrides $MCP_GATEWAY_CONFIG and the platform
                                default)
  -v, --verbose...              Increase log verbosity
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-error output
      --json                    Emit JSON on stdout
      --color <COLOR>           Colorize output [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always,
                                never]
      --allow-private-networks  Reach RFC1918, ULA, and loopback (local / branch APIs). Loud opt-in
  -h, --help                    Print help
  -V, --version                 Print version
